newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer third qtr net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer third qtr net profit falls.

text.p: Placer Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday net profit was A$9.6 million for the three months to September 30, 1996.
Placer Pacific reported a net profit of A$16.7 million for the corresponding period a year earlier.
Placer Pacific, 70 percent owned by Placer Dome Inc, said net profit for the nine months to September was A$28.1 million, compared with A$46.0 million a year earlier.
It said sales for the September quarter was A$119.6 million, compared with A$127.8 million in the 1995 September quarter.

Sales for the nine months rose 17 percent to A$415.7 million it said. Cost of sales increased by 37 percent to A$259.62 million in the same period, reflecting higher costs of gold production and lower profit margins from copper sales.
It said its equity share of gold output was 575,017 ounces for the nine months, compared with 563,617 ounces a year ago.

Placer Pacific said total gold and copper production is expected to rise in the final quarter of 1996, with higher output expected from the Porgera mine in Papua New Guinea and Osborne in northwest Queensland.

The average cash cost for gold output for the group was A$364 per ounce for the quarter, compared with A$290 a year earlier and A$348 per ounce for the nine months, compared with A$290 a year ago, Placer said.
At 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT), Placer shares were steady at A$1.65.
